clue.text: Changed over coaches, missing one, then taken by boat, missing another one

indicators.note: missing says the coaches word goes without the letter for one

parts.note: railway coaches make up trains
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: missing again says the boat word loses its own letter for one

parts.note: ferried means carried across water by boat
a second I, again the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A traveller's awkward journey: changing coaches, losing a companion, then a ferry crossing where someone else goes missing.
explanation.walkthrough: Both words lose an I: TRAINS becomes TRANS and FERRIED becomes FERRED.
explanation.definitionFit: Something transferred has been moved or switched from one place or holder to another.

clue.text: Thing to put in order this evening

indicators.note: putting letters in order means rearranging them, here the letters of thing to

explanation.surface: A to-do list item: something to sort out this evening.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb names the coming night of the present day, the same time as this evening.

clue.text: One young lass astray

parts.note: A means one, as in a single thing
a miss is a young unmarried girl

explanation.surface: A girl who has wandered off and gone missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something gone wrong or off course, as in 'go amiss'.

clue.text: Adjusted glass in apparatus for transmitting information

indicators.note: adjusted says the letters of glass in are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A technician fitting glass into some piece of communications equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: Railway signals are devices that pass instructions to drivers, a way of conveying messages.

clue.text: Refined English member with a set of books

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body
NT, the New Testament, is a collection of biblical books

explanation.surface: A cultivated Englishman, part of a club, who owns a fine library.
explanation.definitionFit: Graceful and stylish in manner or taste, the quality of polished sophistication.

clue.text: Feel remorse about resolution to provide job for an MP

indicators.note: about means the remorse word goes around the resolution letters

parts.note: to repent is to feel sorry for wrongdoing
RES is a short form of resolution, as in screen resolution or a formal motion

explanation.surface: A politician regretting a motion they had backed in the House.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolution' looks like a firm decision, but it is just its short form, as in screen resolution.
explanation.definitionFit: An MP's role is to speak and act for the constituents who elected them.

clue.text: Sweet course: son tucked into justly earned thing

indicators.note: tucked into means the son letter is placed inside the earned word

parts.note: a desert is what one deserves, as in 'just deserts'
S is the abbreviation for son in genealogies

explanation.surface: A boy tucking into pudding he feels he has earned.
explanation.definitionFit: The final sweet dish of a meal is the pudding course.

clue.text: Forceful call centre nag him, occasionally

indicators.note: centre says the picked letters go into the middle of the call word

parts.note: to ring someone is to phone, or call, them

indicators.note: occasionally picks every other letter of nag him, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A call-centre worker pestering a man with insistent phone calls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'call centre' looks like one phrase but splits: 'call' gives the word and 'centre' says where the picked letters go, right in its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: A ringing endorsement is a resounding, emphatic one, delivered with force.

clue.text: Provision of substitute for wonky temperance, consuming alcohol finally

indicators.note: consuming means the rearranged letters swallow up that final letter
wonky means crooked or askew, so the letters of temperance are rearranged
finally takes the last letter of alcohol

explanation.surface: A shaky abstinence pledge broken when someone finally drinks alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: A replacement is something supplied to stand in for what has been lost or removed.

clue.text: Deprived of cover, former partner assumed an attitude

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
posed means took up a stance, physical or affected

explanation.surface: An ex-partner striking a pose while stripped of covering.
explanation.definitionFit: Something laid bare and unprotected has had its shelter taken away.

clue.text: Offspring drawn regularly into paths leading downwards

indicators.note: into means the picked letters go inside the downward paths word

parts.note: descents are routes going downhill

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of drawn, the first, third and fifth

explanation.surface: Children pulled down sloping tracks, perhaps on a sledge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawn' looks like a verb describing the offspring, but it is only the source of the alternate letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Children, grandchildren and later generations are the progeny of an ancestor.

clue.text: Publicly calls for literary writings

definitions.meaning: first meaning: summons someone over a public address system
second meaning: sheets of written work

explanation.walkthrough: One sense is the verb used in airports and hospitals; the other is the plural noun for leaves of a book.
explanation.definitionFit: To page someone is to announce their name aloud to fetch them, and written texts are made of pages.

clue.text: Consciousness of garbled answers with disheartened age

indicators.note: garbled means jumbled, so the pooled letters are mixed up
disheartened removes the middle of age, leaving its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone becoming aware of muddled replies as they grow older and gloomier.
explanation.walkthrough: Pool ANSWERS with AE (age minus its heart G) and rearrange the nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Awareness is the state of knowing or perceiving something, the same mental state as consciousness.

clue.text: A compulsory financial levy, we're told, approaches

indicators.note: we're told means the phrase is heard rather than read, so a sound-alike is wanted

parts.note: A gives A; a tax is a compulsory charge imposed by the state

explanation.surface: A dry definition of tax, as if from a textbook.
explanation.definitionFit: To attack a task is to tackle or set about it, which is how one approaches a problem.

clue.text: Smoke Channel Islands fish better trimmed at both ends

parts.note: CI is the abbreviation for the Channel Islands, Jersey and Guernsey among them
the gar is a long-snouted fish

indicators.note: trimmed at both ends means better loses its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Smoked fish from the Channel Islands, improved by a little trimming.
explanation.definitionFit: A smoke is informal for something smoked, typically a rolled tobacco stick.

clue.text: Scene of action's menace with resistance pushed back east

indicators.note: pushed back means the resistance letter is shifted further along the menace word

parts.note: a threat is a menace
R is the symbol for electrical resistance
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A military report: menace and resistance driven back eastwards.
explanation.walkthrough: Moving the R of THREAT to the end gives THEATR, then E is added.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre of war is the region where fighting and military operations take place.

clue.text: Combined after base came into view

indicators.note: after means the combined word follows the base letter

parts.note: e is the base of natural logarithms
merged means joined together

explanation.surface: Forces that united and then appeared from their base.
explanation.definitionFit: To emerge is to come out from hiding and become visible.

clue.text: Copy passages from old political pamphlet

parts.note: ex- means former or old, as in ex-president
a tract is a short pamphlet arguing a cause

explanation.surface: Someone quoting lines from a historic campaign leaflet.
explanation.definitionFit: To extract text is to take out and reproduce selected portions of a longer work.

clue.text: Figure of helper upset over weight

indicators.note: over means the turned helper sits above the weight in the down entry
upset in a down clue means the helper word is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: an aid is something or someone that helps
a gram is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A distressed assistant's shape, standing over a weight on scales.
explanation.definitionFit: In a book, a figure is an illustrative drawing or chart.

clue.text: Piece of inflammable material journalist made harmonious

parts.note: a match is a small stick tipped to catch fire
ED, short for editor, is the crossword's usual journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter handling a flammable stick and calming a heated room.
explanation.definitionFit: Colours or items that are matched have been paired to go well together.

clue.text: Very little mother? The smallest possible

parts.note: mini means tiny, very small
mum is British informal for mother

explanation.surface: Asking whether a petite mother counts as the tiniest one around.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest amount or degree allowed or attainable is the least that can be had.

clue.text: More highbrow gag about current head of Russia

indicators.note: about means the gag word goes around the current letter

parts.note: to heave is to retch or gag
I is the physics symbol for electric current

indicators.note: head of takes the first letter of Russia

explanation.surface: An intellectual joke involving Russia's leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gag' suggests a joke, but here it is the verb meaning retch.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy writing or music is serious and demanding, so a heavier piece is weightier, less light entertainment.

clue.text: Host of internet broadcast's biting answer

indicators.note: biting means the rearranged letters take the answer letter between their teeth
broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters of internet are rearranged

explanation.surface: An online host gives a sharp, cutting reply to a question.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange INTERNET to ENTERTIN, then put A inside to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To host guests is to receive and look after them, offering hospitality.

clue.text: Support for women with essentially fine intellect

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

indicators.note: essentially takes the essence, the middle letters, of fine

explanation.surface: A campaigner backing women of fine intellect.
explanation.definitionFit: Brain is used for mental capacity, the power of thinking and reasoning.

clue.text: Inflamed with passion only involving our navy

indicators.note: involving means the only word wraps around the navy letters

parts.note: but means only, as in 'but a child'
RN is the Royal Navy, Britain's navy

explanation.surface: A sailor's love affair kept within the navy.
explanation.definitionFit: Burning with desire figuratively means consumed by strong emotion, the past participle describing one fired up.

clue.text: Area of land or vehicle working it

parts.note: a tract is a stretch of land

explanation.surface: A field and the farm machine that ploughs it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' in the definition refers back to the area of land, so the definition depends on the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A farm machine pulling ploughs and harrows is the vehicle that cultivates a field.

clue.text: Limits spoil drinks

parts.note: to mar is to damage or spoil
gins are glasses of the spirit

explanation.surface: Restrictions that spoil drinking, perhaps a two-drink rule.
explanation.definitionFit: Margins are edges or boundaries, the outer bounds of something.

clue.text: Measuring instrument — article Republican doctor encountered in front of emergency room

indicators.note: in front of means the encountered word comes before the emergency room letters

parts.note: the is the definite article
MO is a medical officer, a doctor
met means encountered

explanation.surface: A political doctor meeting a colleague outside the ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A gauge for temperature is a device that takes readings, used by doctors.
